sections.Profile:
Super Panic Ball, developed by Bandai Namco in 2019, is a head-to-head pinball machine that combines elements of traditional pinball with competitive multiplayer gameplay. The game features two opposing playfields, allowing players to compete directly against each other.

- Manufacturer: Bandai Namco
- Years made: 2019
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, 2010s, Head-to-Head, Solid State
